import PV_L2C_DigestEncode
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_DigestRoundtrip
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine AspisR1TerminalDecoder

theorem decode (d : Array U32 8#usize) (hd : Canon8 d) :
    atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) = ok (.Ok d) := by
  have h0 := PV_L2C_DigestEncode.scalar d hd 0 (by omega)
  change aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[0]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[1]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[2]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[3]!]) = ok (some d.val[0]!) at h0
  have h1 := PV_L2C_DigestEncode.scalar d hd 1 (by omega)
  change aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[4]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[5]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[6]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[7]!]) = ok (some d.val[1]!) at h1
  have h2 := PV_L2C_DigestEncode.scalar d hd 2 (by omega)
  change aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[8]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[9]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[10]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[11]!]) = ok (some d.val[2]!) at h2
  have h3 := PV_L2C_DigestEncode.scalar d hd 3 (by omega)
  change aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[12]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[13]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[14]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[15]!]) = ok (some d.val[3]!) at h3
  have h4 := PV_L2C_DigestEncode.scalar d hd 4 (by omega)
  change aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[16]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[17]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[18]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[19]!]) = ok (some d.val[4]!) at h4
  have h5 := PV_L2C_DigestEncode.scalar d hd 5 (by omega)
  change aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[20]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[21]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[22]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[23]!]) = ok (some d.val[5]!) at h5
  have h6 := PV_L2C_DigestEncode.scalar d hd 6 (by omega)
  change aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[24]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[25]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[26]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[27]!]) = ok (some d.val[6]!) at h6
  have h7 := PV_L2C_DigestEncode.scalar d hd 7 (by omega)
  change aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[28]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[29]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[30]!,(PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d).val[31]!]) = ok (some d.val[7]!) at h7
  unfold atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 0#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 1#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 2#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 3#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 4#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 5#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 6#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 7#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 8#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 9#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 10#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 11#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 12#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 13#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 14#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 15#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 16#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 17#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 18#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 19#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 20#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 21#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 22#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 23#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 24#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 25#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 26#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 27#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 28#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 29#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 30#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  rw [index_ok (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) 31#usize (by scalar_tac)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  rw [h0]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,core.option.Option.ok_or,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
  rw [h1]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,core.option.Option.ok_or,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
  rw [h2]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,core.option.Option.ok_or,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
  rw [h3]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,core.option.Option.ok_or,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
  rw [h4]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,core.option.Option.ok_or,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
  rw [h5]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,core.option.Option.ok_or,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
  rw [h6]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,core.option.Option.ok_or,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
  rw [h7]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,core.option.Option.ok_or,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
  congr 2
  apply R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical.array_ext
  intro j hj
  have hj' : j < 8 := by simpa using hj
  interval_cases j <;> rfl
#print axioms decode

theorem origin (d : Array U32 8#usize) (hd : Canon8 d) : PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin d :=
  .decoded (PV_L2C_DigestEncode.encode d) (decode d hd)
#print axioms origin
end PV_L2C_DigestRoundtrip

import PV_L2C_ClientRoute
import PV_L2C_MaskRange
import PV_L2C_BaseGuard
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R1Z

def column (bank : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank) (c : Fin 16) : List U32 :=
  List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 1024 => (⟨bank c r⟩ : U32))

theorem bank_expected (bank : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank) (hc : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Canonical bank)
    (c : Fin 16) : PV_L2C_BaseGuard.check (column bank c) = .ok () := by
  apply PV_L2C_BaseGuard.expected
  · simp only [column,List.length_ofFn]
  · intro j hj
    rw [column,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_ofFn,dif_pos hj]
    exact hc c ⟨j,hj⟩
#print axioms bank_expected

def bank (columns : PV_Src_ForestTrace.Columns) : PV_L2C_MaskRange.Bank :=
  fun c r => (PV_Src_Forest_Columns.read columns ⟨c.val,by omega⟩ r).bv

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]
include K in
theorem transfer_bank (t : PV_L2C_ClientRoute.Transfer) :
    PV_L2C_MaskRange.Canonical (bank t.compiled.semantic_c1.c1) := by
  intro c r
  exact (PV_L2C_ClientRoute.transfer_columns (K:=K) t).2 ⟨c.val,by omega⟩ r
#print axioms transfer_bank

include K in
theorem withdrawal_bank (t : PV_L2C_ClientRoute.Withdrawal) :
    PV_L2C_MaskRange.Canonical (bank t.compiled.semantic_c1.c1) := by
  intro c r
  exact (PV_L2C_ClientRoute.withdrawal_columns (K:=K) t).2 ⟨c.val,by omega⟩ r
#print axioms withdrawal_bank

include K in
theorem transfer_masked (t : PV_L2C_ClientRoute.Transfer)
    (cells : List (PV_L2C_MaskRange.Cell × PV_L2C_M31.word))
    (hm : ∀ cm ∈ cells, PV_L2C_M31.canonical cm.2)
    (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (dependent : Fin 16 → Usize) (c : Fin 16) :
    PV_L2C_BaseGuard.check (column
      (PV_L2C_MaskRange.balance (PV_L2C_MaskRange.applyCells
        (bank t.compiled.semantic_c1.c1) cells) active dependent) c) = .ok () :=
  bank_expected _ (PV_L2C_MaskRange.application _ (transfer_bank (K:=K) t) cells hm active dependent) c
#print axioms transfer_masked

include K in
theorem withdrawal_masked (t : PV_L2C_ClientRoute.Withdrawal)
    (cells : List (PV_L2C_MaskRange.Cell × PV_L2C_M31.word))
    (hm : ∀ cm ∈ cells, PV_L2C_M31.canonical cm.2)
    (active : Fin 1024 → Bool) (dependent : Fin 16 → Usize) (c : Fin 16) :
    PV_L2C_BaseGuard.check (column
      (PV_L2C_MaskRange.balance (PV_L2C_MaskRange.applyCells
        (bank t.compiled.semantic_c1.c1) cells) active dependent) c) = .ok () :=
  bank_expected _ (PV_L2C_MaskRange.application _ (withdrawal_bank (K:=K) t) cells hm active dependent) c
#print axioms withdrawal_masked
end PV_L2C_RouteBaseGuard
